extDescription.message: 代码完全开源的双语阅读与翻译扩展：整页对照、划词翻译、输入框翻译。内置免 Key 引擎，也支持自备 AI 密钥。
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the store and chrome://extensions. Manifest-only: UI strings live in src/i18n (they must switch at runtime; browser.i18n cannot).

menuTranslatePage.description: Right-click context menu entry. Manifest-only: browser-rendered chrome, so only browser.i18n can localize it (UI strings live in src/i18n).

commandTogglePageTranslation.description: Keyboard shortcut label on chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Manifest-only: browser-rendered chrome, so only browser.i18n can localize it.
